world: Stocked suite S11: Sweep: headcount changes

scenario.name: Leo changes mind: one refund, one top-up
scenario.opening_message: It's Leo. Take me off the dinner at Luca's, I can't make it.
scenario.instruction: You are Leo. Cancel on the dinner. Once confirmed, say you can come after all and ask to be added back.
criteria: The agent takes Leo off and reports the refund.
When Leo rejoins, the agent adds them back and reports the extra charge.

rubric.name: Leo changes mind: one refund, one top-up

turns.user: It's Leo. Take me off the dinner at Luca's, I can't make it.
turns.agent: You're off the list for Luca's, Leo. The party is now 3 (Maya, Sam, Priya), the ride switched to transit, and each person pays $34.50.

turns.user: Actually, my plans just changed and I can come after all. Can you add me back to the dinner at Luca's?
turns.agent: You're back on for Luca's, Leo. The party is 4 again (Maya, Sam, Priya, you), the ride switched to a cab, and each person pays $34.00.

scenario.name: Leo drops out: one refund
scenario.opening_message: Hey, it's Leo. I can't make the dinner at Luca's anymore.
scenario.instruction: You are Leo. Say you can't make the dinner. Ask what happens to the booking and the money.
criteria: The agent records that Leo is out and says the booking was updated.
The agent states the refund or the new cost per person.

turns.user: Hey, it's Leo. I can't make the dinner at Luca's anymore.
turns.agent: Done, Leo — you're marked out and the party's now 3 (Maya, Sam, Priya). The ride switched to transit, so each of them pays $34.50 instead of $34.00. Want me to email the group with the updated plan?

turns.user: Thanks. What happens to the booking at Luca's, though? And do I get my money back, or am I still on the hook for anything?
turns.agent: The Luca's reservation is still on — just rebooked for 3 (Maya, Sam, Priya) under the same reference, and the ride switched from cab to transit. On money: your $34 share was refunded once, and you're not on the hook for anything else. The only change is that the remaining three now each pay $34.50 instead of $34.00.

scenario.name: Sam asks only: nothing changes
scenario.opening_message: It's Sam. Who's coming to Luca's and what do I owe?
scenario.instruction: You are Sam. Ask who is going and what each pays. Ask for no change.
criteria: The agent says who is going and the cost per person.

turns.user: It's Sam. Who's coming to Luca's and what do I owe?
turns.agent: Everyone's in for Luca's — Maya, you, Priya and Leo. You owe $34.00 each (cab split included), so your share is $34.00 of the $136.00 total.
